actions.reason: K8_C0001 has an interpretable transcriptomic identity (coordinated down-regulation of oxidative phosphorylation, estrogen-response-late, adipogenesis, and fatty-acid-metabolism programs). Its exact-set membership representation is conflicting: CT/RNA/WSI show non-separation while WXS separates strongly, so membership is not uniformly positive. However, the two nominated pair reviews (K8_C0001|K8_C0006 and K8_C0001|K8_C0004) both show the current boundary represented in the consensus geometry (within-set affinity exceeding between-set affinity, high ARI, substantial normalized-cut cost) with retained internal subdivision structure in the union, which favors preserving distinct units rather than merging. No plausible structural alternative remains that would change the disposition, so the candidate is retained as an independent unit.

K8_C0002 has an interpretable transcriptomic identity (coordinated down-regulation of immune/inflammatory programs with up-regulation of oxidative phosphorylation and fatty-acid metabolism). Its exact-set membership representation is coherently weak across all four native geometries (non-positive silhouettes, within distances at or above nearest-competing distances), so membership is not positively represented. The two nominated pair reviews (K8_C0002|K8_C0003 and K8_C0002|K8_C0005) both show the current boundary represented in the consensus geometry with no dominant union subdivision signal, which is compatible with preserving distinct units and does not support merge.
